name: dev-loop
description: Autonomous dev-loop guardrails and skills: protection hooks (no pushes/commits to protected branches, no .env/secret writes, no committing live secrets, no backtick-mangled -m commit messages), a SessionStart hook (situational-awareness + retro-nudge + git-identity-check + config-drift-check + vault & .cracked-dev/state read-back), two Stop hooks (one nudges an end-of-session retro capture into the git-backed stores; one opens a deterministic vault-tidy PR — wikilinks + frontmatter — against the vault, worktree-isolated, branch-only), a Supabase/Stripe/PHI security-reviewer subagent, and the /ship, /babysit-prs, /create-migration, /deploy-edge-function, /retro, /spike skills.
